# Velys UI (velys)

> A vanilla-extract-based React design system inspired by Vercel Geist. Zero-runtime CSS, light/dark tokens, ESM/CJS + `.d.ts`. Every component is bound to semantic design tokens.

> Prefer the single-file inlined reference when you want everything at once: [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt).

Usage rules for LLMs/coding agents:
- Install: `npm i @velody/velys react react-dom`
- Import the stylesheet **exactly once**: `import "@velody/velys/styles.css";`
- Apply a theme class at the app root so CSS variables are provided: `lightThemeClass` or `darkThemeClass` (both exported from `@velody/velys`).
- When using colors/spacing directly, use `vars` (e.g. `vars.color.text.primary`, `vars.space.md`) and avoid hardcoding hex/px.
- All components support `forwardRef` + native DOM attribute passthrough (unless noted otherwise). `className` is merged onto the root.
- Variant values are string literal unions. The Props table in each doc below is the source of truth.

## Setup

```tsx
import "@velody/velys/styles.css";
import { lightThemeClass, Button } from "@velody/velys";

export default function App() {
  return (
    <div className={lightThemeClass}>
      <Button tone="primary">Get started</Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Components

- [Button](docs/components/Button.md): solid/outline/ghost × primary/danger × sm/md/lg button
- [IconButton](docs/components/IconButton.md): square icon button (aria-label required)
- [Badge](docs/components/Badge.md): status/category label (6 color × solid/subtle)
- [Input](docs/components/Input.md): text input (sm/md/lg, invalid, icon slot)
- [Textarea](docs/components/Textarea.md): multi-line input
- [Select](docs/components/Select.md): hybrid select — custom accessible listbox on desktop, native <select> on touch (sm/md/lg, invalid, placeholder)
- [Checkbox](docs/components/Checkbox.md): checkbox (checked/indeterminate, label/description)
- [Radio](docs/components/Radio.md): radio + RadioGroup
- [Switch](docs/components/Switch.md): toggle switch
- [Card](docs/components/Card.md): container (elevated/outlined/filled) + CardTitle/CardDescription
- [Avatar](docs/components/Avatar.md): user avatar (image/initials/icon)
- [Alert](docs/components/Alert.md): inline banner (5 status × subtle/solid/outline)
- [Toast](docs/components/Toast.md): notification toast
- [EmptyState](docs/components/EmptyState.md): empty-state placeholder
- [Tabs](docs/components/Tabs.md): tabs (compound: Tabs/TabList/Tab/TabPanel)
- [Tooltip](docs/components/Tooltip.md): hover tooltip (4 directions)
- [DropdownMenu](docs/components/DropdownMenu.md): dropdown menu (Menu/MenuItem/MenuSeparator/MenuLabel)
- [Modal](docs/components/Modal.md): modal dialog (portal, controlled)
- [Label](docs/components/Label.md): form label (+ Field wrapper) — brand on focus, red on invalid
- [Text](docs/components/Text.md): semantic body/inline text (size/weight/tone) + Code/Kbd
- [Heading](docs/components/Heading.md): section heading (level h1–h4, display size)
- [Spinner](docs/components/Spinner.md): indeterminate loading indicator (sm/md/lg)
- [Progress](docs/components/Progress.md): linear + CircularProgress (determinate/indeterminate)
- [Skeleton](docs/components/Skeleton.md): loading placeholder (text/rectangular/circular)
- [Popover](docs/components/Popover.md): floating panel (compound, portal, side/align)
- [Drawer](docs/components/Drawer.md): edge-anchored sheet (left/right/top/bottom, portal)
- [Accordion](docs/components/Accordion.md): collapsible sections (single/multiple)
- [Separator](docs/components/Separator.md): divider (horizontal/vertical)
- [Breadcrumb](docs/components/Breadcrumb.md): navigation trail (compound)
- [Pagination](docs/components/Pagination.md): page navigation with truncated ranges
- [Slider](docs/components/Slider.md): single-value range slider (keyboard + pointer)
- [Table](docs/components/Table.md): data table (compound, striped/interactive rows)
- [Link](docs/components/Link.md): styled anchor (brand/neutral/inherit tone, underline control, external affordance)
- [Stack](docs/components/Stack.md): flex layout primitive (row/column, token-bound gap, align/justify/wrap)
- [StatusDot](docs/components/StatusDot.md): colored status indicator dot (6 statuses, optional label, pulse)
- [Tag](docs/components/Tag.md): dismissible chip (6 colors × subtle/outline, close button)
- [Toggle](docs/components/Toggle.md): pressable toggle button (aria-pressed) + ToggleGroup (single/multiple, segmented)
- [CopyButton](docs/components/CopyButton.md): copy-to-clipboard icon button with copied feedback
- [Snippet](docs/components/Snippet.md): terminal command line(s) with copy-to-clipboard
- [Collapsible](docs/components/Collapsible.md): disclosure primitive (Trigger/Content, animated, controlled/uncontrolled)
- [NumberInput](docs/components/NumberInput.md): numeric input with steppers (min/max/step, spinbutton keyboard)
- [RangeSlider](docs/components/RangeSlider.md): dual-thumb range slider ([lower, upper], keyboard + pointer)
- [Combobox](docs/components/Combobox.md): filterable autocomplete input + listbox (compound: Combobox/ComboboxInput/ComboboxList/ComboboxItem/ComboboxEmpty; single-select, ARIA 1.2)
- [CommandMenu](docs/components/CommandMenu.md): cmdk-style command palette dialog (CommandInput/List/Group/Item/Empty/Separator; substring filter, optional mod+K shortcut)
- [Calendar](docs/components/Calendar.md): month grid date selection (role=grid keyboard nav, min/max, weekStartsOn, Intl localization)
- [DatePicker](docs/components/DatePicker.md): text input + calendar popup (Date value, ISO + locale parsing, sm/md/lg, invalid, portal)
- [Icons](docs/components/Icons.md): built-in currentColor icon set (16 icons, exported from the package root)

## Providers & Hooks

- [Providers & Hooks](docs/providers.md): `VelysProvider` (theme + toast host), `useTheme`, `useToast`, `useDisclosure`, `useMediaQuery`/`usePrefersDark`

## Tokens

- [Design tokens](docs/tokens.md): the full set of color (light/dark), space, radius, font, motion (duration/easing), and shadow tokens exposed via `vars`
